justification: Frontend display-only de-dupe on the Intelligence Brief page: lot area was shown three times (Economics, Strata & Cadastre, and inside the Planning lot-dimensions composite). Now the standalone lot_area_m2 renders only in Economics, and the area is stripped from the lot-dimensions composite (which keeps frontage/depth/corner). No data or logic change.

pre_impl.existing_data: SectionData renders each section's fields generically. lot_area_m2 is a field in both the economics and strata section values, and area_m2 is a key inside the planning lot_dimensions object — so the same number rendered in three places.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The generic renderer showed every field, duplicating lot area across three cards. The fix scopes the standalone figure to Economics and removes the redundant area from the dimensions composite.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component or data. The SectionData filter drops lot_area_m2 unless the section is economics; a small pure helper stripDimArea removes area_m2/lot_area_m2 from the lot_dimensions object before it is formatted.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No data or network change. stripDimArea returns the value unchanged for any non-object or non-dimensions field, so an unexpected shape renders exactly as before.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). stripDimArea is typed (key: string, value: unknown) -> unknown and guards against null/array/non-object before destructuring.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: lot area appeared three times across the brief. After: it appears once (Economics) and the Planning dimensions read as frontage/depth/corner.

functions.name: stripDimArea
functions.input: a field key and its value from a brief section, to be rendered in the generic data list
functions.output: the value unchanged, except the lot_dimensions composite has its area key removed so area is not shown again
functions.if_none: any non lot_dimensions key or a null, array or non-object value is returned unchanged so other fields render as before

values: N/A - no regulatory values. The change only controls which copy of the lot area is displayed; the numbers themselves are unchanged.
queries: N/A - frontend render change; no database or API query is added.

break_it.scenario: The lot_dimensions object is null, an array, or a non-object for some property
break_it.what_happens: destructuring a non-object to strip the area key would throw and break the section
break_it.repro: stripDimArea('lot_dimensions', null) and stripDimArea('lot_dimensions', []) both return the input unchanged
break_it.how: the helper guards on key, truthiness, typeof object and not Array before touching the value

break_it.scenario: A non-economics section also carries a lot_area_m2 field (e.g. Strata)
break_it.what_happens: showing it duplicates the Economics figure, the reported 3x
break_it.repro: the entries filter drops key lot_area_m2 when section is not economics
break_it.how: the filter keeps lot_area_m2 only in the economics section, so the standalone figure appears once

break_it.scenario: Economics itself must still show the lot area
break_it.what_happens: an over-broad filter could hide the canonical figure entirely
break_it.repro: the filter condition only drops lot_area_m2 when section !== 'economics', so Economics keeps it
break_it.how: the de-dupe is scoped to non-economics sections, leaving the one canonical Economics figure intact

post_merge.manual_verify: On the deployed brief, confirm lot area shows once (Economics), is gone from Strata & Cadastre, and the Planning lot-dimensions reads frontage/depth/corner without repeating the area.
